title: EUDR Sustainability Compliance
thesis: Snowflake indexes the full EUDR regulation, parses certification documents with AI, and tracks compliance gaps across 200 plantations — all native SQL, no external NLP platform needed

talking_points: EUDR deadline in 87 days — 23 of 200 plantations non-compliant (11.5%).
RM 4.8 billion in annual export revenue at risk if non-compliant shipments are blocked.
500 EUDR clauses indexed and mapped to plantation-level obligations.
show: Highlight the 23 red-status plantations on the map

transition.line: Let's drill into which plantations are failing and which clauses they're missing.

talking_points: Article 9 geolocation evidence is the biggest gap — 15 plantations missing polygon data.
AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT extracted 1,500 certifications — 47 expired or expiring within 60 days.
ML.CLASSIFICATION flags 23 plantations as HIGH RISK based on combined gap scoring.
show: Point at the risk classification distribution
tabs.call_out: 15 plantations missing geolocation — the #1 EUDR requirement

transition.line: These gaps are fixable. Let's see what the regulation actually requires.

talking_points: Full text of EU Regulation 2023/1115 indexed in Cortex Search — 500 clauses searchable.
Search: 'smallholder exemptions' returns Article 10 provisions for plots under 4 hectares.
Every compliance gap is linked to the specific EUDR article it violates.
show: Show search results with Article references
Click through to specific clause text
tabs.call_out: 500 EUDR clauses — instant semantic search, no legal team required

transition.line: Now let the CEO ask the system in plain language.

talking_points: Dato' Sri asks: 'What's our total revenue at risk from non-compliant plantations?'
Cortex Analyst writes the query, returns: RM 4.8B across 23 plantations.
Follow-up: 'What's the fastest path to compliance for the Sabah estates?' — agent searches EUDR and recommends actions.
show: Type: 'What revenue is at risk from non-compliant plantations?'

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
In Snowflake-only mode — AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT replaces Textract, Cortex Search replaces Comprehend.
Malaysia is world's 2nd largest palm oil producer. EUDR compliance is existential for the industry.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native SQL, EUDR-ready in 87 days

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for palm oil sustainability compliance.
